fusions.name: Snare Loop
fusions.desc: Casts a loop of strands at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 11 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. Their damage rises 8% per affliction on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, for 10 seconds, and raises your armour by 8%.

fusions.name: Tightening Weave
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (163% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
